# Test fixtures

Checked-in fixtures used by `tests/*`.

| Directory | Purpose |
|-----------|---------|
| `doc_reference/` | Doc parser / section tests (`.md`, `.rst`, `.txt`, `.ipynb`, `.html`). |
| `code_reference/` | Code extractor and language coverage tests. |
| `lang_samples/` | Small single-file snippets for language/parser smoke tests. |

Synthetic multi-file Python repos are generated by `codesight_mcp::test_support::{write_small_repo, write_medium_repo, write_hierarchy_repo}`.

When tests need new fixture coverage, add or update files in place here and run `cargo test -p codesight-mcp`.
